title: Mobtown Ballroom

services.name: Dance Classes
services.desc: Students in our classes learn Lindy Hop, the original form of swing dance. Classes take place in 6 week long series with some of the best teachers in the region. Students rotate in class (Lindy Hop is a social dance), so no partner is required. We encourage you to sign up for class as early as possible so that we can maintain a lead/follow balance. Students are welcome to pick either the lead or the follow role (and many people learn both over time), but we do ask that they stick to one role for the duration of each class series. services.name: Class
services.desc: This class requires, at a minimum, that you have completed the Lindy 1 six-week series. We will continue to hone your basics throughout the class, but the syllabus is heavy on moves and vocabulary, which are organized to emphasize specific aspects of technique each week. There will be more material than you can master during the hour long class, so outside practice is crucial. Our goal for the end of the series is to have you dancing a wide chunk of basic Lindy Hop material with increasing confidence.
